NGX_GEOIP_CITY_NAME is not a constant I can verify in nginx's source. In `src/http/modules/ngx_http_geoip_module.c`, nginx defines only three numeric selectors — `NGX_GEOIP_COUNTRY_CODE` (0), `NGX_GEOIP_COUNTRY_CODE3` (1), `NGX_GEOIP_COUNTRY_NAME` (2) — used with the country database; the city-database variables (`geoip_city`, `geoip_region_name`, etc.) are dispatched via `offsetof(GeoIPRecord, ...)`, not via a named `NGX_GEOIP_CITY_*` macro. To my knowledge no `NGX_GEOIP_CITY_NAME` exists in the tree, and I can't check the current dev source offline, so I won't guess a value.

ANSWER: unknown
